title: SAP Web Dispatcher does not sufficiently validate certain network input processed by an internal… (CVE-2026-89126)
description: SAP Web Dispatcher contains a vulnerability where it does not sufficiently validate certain network input processed by an internal component. This flaw allows an unauthenticated attacker to send specially crafted network traffic that triggers a memory corruption condition. Exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, fully compromising the affected system and severely impacting confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
